mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (event_id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_type, operation_id, payload, status, claim_epoch, lease_until, next_attempt_at, published_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{aggregateVersion}, #{eventType}, #{operationId}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), 'PENDING', 0, NULL, #{now}, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_type, operation_id, CAST(payload AS CHAR) AS payload, status, claim_epoch, retry_base_epoch, version, created_at FROM outbox_event WHERE (status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}) OR (status='CLAIMED' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until<#{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
